No, but the thing is, what I'm saying is, when I was in that bed shop, and I'm going "Oh yeah, good bed, good bed." I'm sitting on it. I'm sitting on a mattress with it. At no point did he say "Now. Have you thought about what sort of…
"Dad!" "What?" "I'll have to get rid of a body" "Let me call Alf!"
